stories.title: Network appliances go more than a year without patches as exploits speed up
stories.why: The median vulnerability on enterprise network appliances stays unpatched for more than a year, Microsoft’s own telemetry shows, even as the most damaging software flaws are being weaponized within days of disclosure.

stories.title: Armed with AI, hackers target endpoint security blind spots, raising stakes for CISOs
stories.why: A China-linked hacking group’s use of AI agents to identify security weaknesses during a global espionage campaign is raising concerns about whether enterprises can detect gaps in their defenses before automated…

stories.title: What a security strategy that survives 2027 looks like
stories.why: Equifax CISO Jeremy Koppen sees the same dynamics most security chiefs are facing: hackers on the one side using AI to perform more sophisticated attacks at unprecedented speed, and defenders on the other adopting AI…

stories.title: Anthropic AI model finds Linux kernel bug that leads to remote root access
stories.why: Linux servers running Multipath TCP (MPTCP) could be vulnerable to remote code execution through a flaw in the kernel’s networking stack.

stories.title: AI coding agents are installing MCP servers that will never be patched
stories.why: When a developer tells an AI coding agent to “set up a GitHub MCP,” the agent has to pick a package.

stories.title: OpenAI raises top bug bounty payout to $172,000 with bonuses
stories.why: OpenAI increased its security bug bounties to encourage independent researchers to find vulnerabilities in its software. The program now offers bonuses for high-quality reports.

stories.title: NCSC Chief Warns of Imminent AI Ransomware Threat to UK Critical Infrastructure
stories.why: The UK’s cyber chief has warned that AI-powered malware is highly likely to feature in ransomware attacks targeting British critical infrastructure by 2028

stories.title: Product showcase: Sweet Virtual Patching stops HTTP2Shell while fixes catch up
stories.why: HTTP2Shell (CVE-2026-111497), the critical Brotli bug first known as Node2Shell, is a remote code execution flaw in the compression library inside Node.js, Bun, Envoy, Python and more.

stories.title: 26,400 Valid Cloud and AI Credentials Found Exposed in Public Gitee Repositories
stories.why: 26,400 credentials that developers left in public code on Gitee, a Chinese code-hosting service, still worked when a researcher tested them. Anyone who copied one from that code could have used it.

stories.title: What human hackers still do better than AI, according to HackerOne’s CEO
stories.why: AI can find vulnerabilities in minutes, but people still hold the edge in judging what a flaw means for a business.
